about: Curated difficulty evidence (noise, overlap, borderline, small disjuncts). One item = one statement in a paper. Read from the PDF text on 19 Oct 2026 by Claude; quotes are verified automatically by build/difficulty_evidence.py against pdftotext output. Not reviewed by Toon yet.

types.inherent: the paper reports a property of a real dataset as it is (measured or described), without changing the data
types.selection rationale: the paper says datasets were chosen because of noise, overlap or other difficulty
types.experimentally injected: the paper adds noise or overlap on purpose (to real data) or generates synthetic data with a controlled level
types.not reported / undetermined: no dataset-level statement found or the statement does not identify datasets or levels

confidence.explicitly reported: property, datasets and level are stated in the text or a table
confidence.partially supported: the property is stated but datasets, level or measurement are not fully stated
confidence.unresolved: keyword hits only, or not reviewed
